dataList.content:
What are you talking about, Aneung. This is the road we would traverse all the time.
你在说什么啊，雅能。我们天天都会经过这条路啊。

Oh... Um... Right.
哦……呃……对。

This... was the place of my day's profession... or the avenue nearby.
这个地方是……我的工作场所……那里的附近。

Hm, you researched by night... and during the day?
嗯，你在晚上搞研究……那白天你干什么呢？

I was an architect.
我是名建筑师。

Ooh~ An architect, huh... That's a neat occupation you had, Yi Sang.
喔~建筑师啊……不错的职位啊，李箱先生。

Neat, you say...
不错吗……

Originally, children used to run in these streets.
原来，这条街上到处都是乱跑的小孩子们。

Although there weren't many... they came into my view on occasion.
即便人数不多……我有时候还是能见到他们。

Even a single abandoned ball could keep a smile on their faces.
就算只能玩一个被丢掉的球，他们也没有失去笑容。

I am vastly fond of youths as well! Are they not the most innocent beings?
吾也十分喜爱孩童们！他们难道不是最纯粹的生命嘛？

dataList.content:
But they're nowhere to be seen now. Where could they have gone?
但现在他们都不见了。都去了哪里呢？

Once children are old enough to learn language, they are taken to factories.
当那些孩子到了该识字的年纪，便会被带去工厂。

Among them are those I made... those factories whose architecture I designed with my hands.
其中有一些我造的……我亲手设计的工厂。

Yi Sang...
李箱……

They were optimized for efficiently monitoring people. It made pressing laborers more convenient than ever.
它们的结构被优化以高效监控人员。压迫工人从未如此便捷。

Perhaps the reason my income has been rather high is that the owners of those buildings run a profitable business.
也许我工资颇高的原因便是，那些工厂的老板们也赚得很多。

Well, even so... It's not like you spent that money to show off.
那，即便如此……你也没有为了炫耀而去花那些钱。

You gave it all for the League.
你把它全部都给了九人会。

...Do you remember? The first thing I invented... after getting a job at T Corp.
……你还记得吗？当我在T公司入职之后……发明的第一件东西。

The identification tags, right?
那些身份标签，对吧？

Yeah, I made them to help lost kids.
对，我是为了帮助走失的孩子们才发明它的。

It's absurd, I know. Maybe I expected it to help more children reunite with their parents.
真好笑呢。我本期望它可以帮助更多孩子与家人团圆的。

But now... they're being used to monitor the workers' time spent on the job in every factory.
但现在……每座工厂都用它来监视工人们的工时。

Heck, I made those things, and even I'm not free from the obligation to wear one while working.
即便那东西是我发明的，我工作时也必须要戴上身份标签。

Those were the kinds of achievements we accomplished in T Corp's district.
那些便是我们在T公司所做出的业绩。

Which is why... I became more engrossed in the mirror.
这也就是为什么……我越来越沉迷于镜子技术。

Untainted, unadulterated... I wished to immerse myself in the pure exploration of knowledge.
纯粹，纯粹地……埋头于自己的研究。

So that... I wouldn't have to take anything from anyone.
为了不去……夺走任何东西。
